identity.description: Meta Marketing API, Meta's ads management and reporting API (Facebook/Instagram ads).
identity.identity_notes: Official Meta developer docs describe the Marketing API for Meta advertising, and the official Ads MCP server is part of the same docs set.

auth.oauth_flows: Facebook OAuth dialog with scope parameter (ads_read, ads_management); Facebook Login for Business dialog used by the MCP server for automatic token handling.
auth.scopes_notes: ads_read and ads_management are the permissions for reading and writing ad data. Standard/Limited access covers only the developer's own ad account; managing other businesses' accounts requires Full/Advanced access. The MCP server supports only Employee-role system user access tokens.

access.production_restrictions: Full Access (formerly Advanced Access) requires App Review per permission/feature; needed for managing other businesses' ad accounts or data. Limited Access is granted automatically once the Marketing API product is added to an app.

read_ops: Retrieve lead data by leadgen_id (Lead Ads)
write_ops: Create campaigns, ad sets, and ads
Create, patch, and delete ad account subscriptions
api.limitations: Full endpoint inventory not fetched. Sources describe ad creation, management, and performance analysis; creatives cannot be changed after creation. Ad account webhooks are separate from Lead Ads Page webhooks. Rate limits not found.

open_questions: Full endpoint inventory and read/write coverage for each object were not fetched.
Rate limits for the Marketing API were not found.

MCP prerequisites conflict: 'Owning a Meta app is not a prerequisite' vs blog's 'any developer with their own Meta app'.
Whether MCP tool access requires Full Access for ad accounts not owned by the developer is unclear.

Community MCP repos (pipeboard-co, byadsco) were identified from search results only and not fetched; ownership judged from names.
